reason: A local DeepSeek Harness dashboard that aggregates agent worktime and usage metrics into period-based statistics, progress views, thread attendance, and rankings.

summaries.zh: 用于在本地统计 DeepSeek Harness 中 Agent 的活跃时长、Token、输入和工具调用，并通过日周月及学年看板展示汇总与进度。
summaries.en: A local DeepSeek Harness dashboard that tracks agent activity time, tokens, inputs, and tool calls, then presents summaries and progress by day, week, month, and academic year.

capabilities: Records local agent activity duration, model token usage, user input counts, and tool-call counts
Aggregates activity data by day, week, month, and academic year
Displays statistics, progress levels, thread attendance, and rankings in a dashboard
Provides a worktime_summary tool for querying period summaries
